name: spomory
description: Explainable graph-retrieval memory for Claude — remembers facts about you and recalls them across conversations.
long_description: Spomory gives Claude a persistent, explainable memory graph: facts you share get extracted into entities and relations, and retrieved with a ranked, cited explanation of why each one matched -- not a black-box vector similarity score. Runs entirely on your machine against your own LLM API key; nothing is sent to Spomory's servers. The same six tools (add_memory, search_memory, forget_memory, forget_all_memory, get_graph, export_memory) are available locally here and over Spomory's optional cloud sync.

tools.name: add_memory
tools.description: Extracts durable facts from text and writes them into the memory graph.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Retrieves relevant facts via personalized PageRank over the memory graph.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Deletes the single fact that best matches a query.

tools.name: forget_all_memory
tools.description: Deletes the entire memory graph (two-step confirm).

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: Returns the subgraph within N hops of an entity.

tools.name: export_memory
tools.description: Exports the full memory graph as a portable JSON document.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API Key
llm_api_key.description: API key for an OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, etc.), used for entity/relation extraction.

llm_base_url.title: LLM Base URL
llm_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Leave as-is for OpenAI, or point at another provider (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com).

embedding_model.title: Embedding Model
embedding_model.description: Model name used for semantic search, called via the same provider's /v1/embeddings endpoint above. Must match whatever you set LLM Base URL to -- e.g. text-embedding-3-small for OpenAI.
